name: Snowflake
description: Connector for Snowflake cloud data warehouse as a batch source and destination. DB-API via snowflake-connector-python. Optimized reads (keyset/offset pagination) and optimized writes (batched multi-row INSERT; flag-gated COPY-INTO-from-stage is dormant in v1.0.0). Native MERGE upsert present but dormant.

supported_versions.batch: Snowflake (all current editions; Standard and Enterprise)

supported_auth_methods.description: Username/password authentication to the Snowflake account. Key-pair (JWT) auth is also supported and recommended for service accounts (Snowflake is phasing out password auth): omit `password` and set the optional `private_key_file` (+ `private_key_file_pwd`) config fields instead — the driver loads and decrypts the PEM key.

account.description: Snowflake account identifier (e.g. xy12345.us-east-1 or orgname-account_name)

password.description: User password (omit when using key-pair auth)

private_key_file.description: Path to a PEM private key file for key-pair auth (alternative to password)

private_key_file_pwd.description: Passphrase for an encrypted private key file

warehouse.description: Virtual warehouse to run queries on

role.description: Role to assume for the session

batch_max_rows.description: Destination only (CDC): the most changed rows written in one batch, a whole number from 1 to 1000000. Leave blank for 10000. Any other value stops the pipeline from starting. Batch (non-CDC) loads are not affected.

batch_max_mb.description: Destination only (CDC): the most data written in one batch, in whole MB from 1 to 1024. Leave blank for 32. Any other value stops the pipeline from starting. Batch (non-CDC) loads are not affected.

batch_interval_seconds.description: Destination only (CDC): the longest changes wait before they are written as one MERGE per table, in whole seconds from 1 to 240. Leave blank for 60. Any other value stops the pipeline from starting. Batch (non-CDC) loads are not affected.

load_strategy.notes: Default bulk write is a batched multi-row INSERT. Flag-gated COPY-INTO-from-stage (RSYNC_SNOWFLAKE_COPY_STAGE) is dormant in v1.0.0 and falls back to multi-row INSERT. Upsert is a native single MERGE INTO (Snowflake supports MERGE).
